contractEnforcements.priorityEngineScope: renderer/js/r3-0d-priority-engine.js consumes ONLY a D3-authoritative Hypothesis Set snapshot validated via PRODUCER ATTESTATION (Codex D4 R3 D4-R3-02 closure). D3 holds a closure-private WeakSet `_authoritativeHypothesisSets` and registers only fully-validated, fully-deep-frozen snapshots inside `buildHypothesisSet`. D3 exposes ONLY the narrow verifier `verifyAuthoritativeHypothesisSet(candidate) → boolean` — never the registry, never a register function, never a sign function, never a raw secret. D4 calls the verifier as the FIRST authority check; clones / JSON round-trips / hand-forged frozen objects with matching hashes all fail because they are different object references. contentSignature + hypothesisSetId remain as INTEGRITY/determinism proofs (defense-in-depth), NOT authority. Caller cannot forge identity even by recomputing both public FNV hashes. Authority verified via a layered model: (a) frozen-input via captured Object.isFrozen; (b) top-level descriptor audit BEFORE clone — rejects accessor descriptors / Symbol keys / non-enumerable on input.hypothesisSet (Codex D4 R1 D4-R1-02 closure); (c) HI.safeStructuredClone defang; (d) post-clone HI.deepOriginalShapeAudit + closed key set check on hypothesisSet (HSET_KEYS_ALLOWED 14 keys); (e) hypothesisSetId FNV-1a 32-bit×2 recompute equality (byte-equivalent to D3 hash); (f) per-hypothesis closed-schema revalidation (Codex D4 R1 D4-R1-01/03 closure) — closed key set (HYPOTHESIS_KEYS_ALLOWED 16 keys), hypothesisId grammar pri_<16hex>, hypothesisId RECOMPUTE equality from (ruleId, supportingIds, contradictingIds) binding the evidence references, ruleId must exist in HE.RULE_REGISTRY, category === rule.category, i18nKey === rule.i18nKey, credibility ≥ rule.minConclusionCredibility, status ∈ HYPOTHESIS_STATUS_ALLOWED {supported, contradicted, inconclusive, blocked}, confidence.state ∈ CONFIDENCE_STATE_ALLOWED {not_computed, insufficient_evidence, low, moderate, high}, confidence.score ∈ [0,100] integer, supporting/contradictingEvidenceIds non-empty strings + cap 64, limitations all valid reason codes + cap 32, cross-field consistency (status=contradicted ⟹ contradictingEvidenceIds.length>0; status=supported ⟹ supportingEvidenceIds.length>0); (g) mandatory freshness reference time via opts.clock() OR opts.referenceNowMs; (h) input + opts descriptor-only snapshot rejecting Symbol/non-enumerable/accessor/function fields — opts.clock MUST be a data descriptor (Codex D4 R1 D4-R1-02 closure); (i) deep-frozen output.
contractEnforcements.fixedPriorityLadder: Hard-coded ladder: (1) fix_data_quality (tier 1) → (2) recalibrate_channel (tier 2) → (3) controlled_repeat_lap (tier 3) → (4) driver_experiment (tier 4) → (5) setup_experiment (tier 5) → collect_additional_session/lap (tier 6) → no_action_required (tier 7). Order MUST NOT be reversed. Within same tier: confidence.score desc, then hypothesisId asc.
contractEnforcements.categoryToKindMapping: data_quality → fix_data_quality; mapping_calibration → recalibrate_channel; driver_behaviour → controlled_repeat_lap; vehicle_response → controlled_repeat_lap; setup_model → setup_experiment (with downgrade to controlled_repeat_lap if not eligibleAsSetupExperiment).
contractEnforcements.closedKindEnum: PRIORITY_KIND_ALLOWED matches D1 hypothesis-contract.VALIDATION_ACTION_KIND_ALLOWED {fix_data_quality, recalibrate_channel, controlled_repeat_lap, driver_experiment, setup_experiment, collect_additional_session, collect_additional_lap, no_action_required}.
contractEnforcements.blockingPrerequisites: Each priority entry lists blockingPrerequisiteIds — IDs of all higher-priority (lower tier number) priorities whose hypothesis has supportable evidence (credibility ≥ Derived AND status not contradicted/blocked). A priority with non-empty blockingPrerequisiteIds cannot become primary. Codex D4 R1 D4-R1-04 closure: TWO-PASS computation — finalize each priority's kind / tier / priorityId FIRST (applying setup_experiment→controlled_repeat_lap downgrade), THEN compute prerequisite IDs against the FINAL priorityIds. This eliminates dangling prerequisite references that occurred when blocking IDs were computed from preliminary (pre-downgrade) kinds.
contractEnforcements.primaryEligibility: primaryActionId points to the highest-rank priority that is eligibleAsPrimary AND has zero blocking prerequisites. eligibleAsPrimary requires: credibility ≥ Derived; status NOT contradicted/blocked; confidence.state ∈ {moderate, high}. setup_experiment additionally requires confidence.state === 'high' + zero contradictions + credibility ≥ Derived (per directive §12 'unsupported setup actions' forbidden — downgraded to controlled_repeat_lap otherwise).
contractEnforcements.rollbackRequired: Every priority entry carries stopConditionI18nKey + rollbackConditionI18nKey. No irreversible action emitted without explicit rollback.
contractEnforcements.noAutoMode: D4 emits descriptive priorities only. NO apply_mode field. NO auto_tuning / auto_setup / auto_calibration / auto_preset (these are D4 FORBIDDEN per directive §10/§12).
contractEnforcements.noLLM: Deterministic. No LLM call. No runtime config.
contractEnforcements.noUI: No DOM mutation, no Alpine binding, no index.html script src. UI is D5_ENGINEER_BRIEF_ACTIVATION.
contractEnforcements.hardenedIntrinsicsEnforced: All ambient calls go through HI. Module-init captures: Object.isFrozen, Date.parse, Object.is. Hash byte-equivalent to D2/D3 (FNV-1a 32-bit×2). Apply D3 R1-R7 lessons proactively (27 known attack patterns avoided).
contractEnforcements.deterministicOutput: Same input Hypothesis Set produces identical prioritySetId, identical priorityIds, identical ranks, identical limitations, identical blockingPrerequisiteIds. Clock-independent for IDs; clock-dependent only for createdAt.
contractEnforcements.caps: PRIORITY_COUNT_CAP=128, PREREQ_ID_PER_PRIORITY_CAP=32, LIMITATIONS_PER_PRIORITY_CAP=32, SNAPSHOT_LIMITATIONS_CAP=64, SNAPSHOT_CANNOT_CONCLUDE_CAP=64, ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP=512 KiB, INPUT_HYPOTHESES_INPUT_CAP=64 (mirror D3 HYPOTHESIS_COUNT_CAP). generationToken ≤ 128 chars; contextVersion ≤ 128 chars.
contractEnforcements.outerTryCatch: buildPrioritySet wrapped in outer try/catch → INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION on any uncaught throw.
contractEnforcements.errorDetailPrivacy: Codex D4 R1 D4-R1-05 closure: fail-closed `detail` strings NEVER echo caller-supplied key names verbatim. A path-like key (e.g. `/Users/x/private.csv`) used as an input own key is reported as 'unknown input own key' — no caller content reaches the output. This applies to input wrapper own-key violations and opts own-key violations alike.
